mapper.select: SELECT t1.lms_user_id, t2.user_name, t4.course_name, t6.company_name, place_name FROM m_lms_user t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN m_user t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id AND delete_flg = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN t_course_user t3 ON t1.lms_user_id = t3.lme_user_id AND delete_flg = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN m_course t4 ON t3.course_id = t4.course_id AND delete_flg = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_company t5 ON t1.lms_user_id = t5.lms_user_id AND delete_flg = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN m.company t6 ON t5.company_id = t6.company_id AND delete_flg = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_place t7 ON t1.lms_user_id = t7.lms_user_id AND delete_flg = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN m_place t8 ON t7.place_id = t8.place_id AND delete_flg = 0 WHERE t4.course_name = #{placeName}
